capabilities: Render a dynamic folder overview via a code block
Summarize the contents of the vault or a chosen folder
extras: Cannot be used together with the Folder Notes plugin; full documentation is hosted externally, not in the README.
intentEvidence: it serves as a standalone alternative for users who only need the folder overview functionality
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to embed a live, self-updating index of a folder's contents inside a note.

relations.evidence: This plugin offers the same functionality as the folder overview feature in the Folder Notes plugin

summary: Renders a dynamic overview of a folder or the whole vault as a code block inside a note.
